name: shopify
description: Connector-owned Shopify Admin API parity ledger rebuilt from current published references, with a fixture-backed Shop stream, 33 typed destructive REST DELETE operations, and a static source-linked command declaration for every documented row; Admin API requests accept only canonical lowercase *.myshopify.com hosts.

risk.read: Fixed Shopify Admin REST/GraphQL reads only; no raw query or arbitrary API passthrough.
risk.write: Only fixed typed REST write operations are declared; destructive deletes require `destructive` confirmation and preview-bound approval.
risk.approval: Writes remain plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; fixture-only evidence is not certification.
